correctness.rationale: On additive group F_q², Fourier orthogonality for graph coefficient g yields ∑_{X,Y}|E_F f|⁴=q^(−2)∑_{s,w}|(g*g)(s,w)|². In exponent two all q diagonal ordered pairs contribute c(0,0)=T=Σf(t)². APN iff nonzero graph two-sum fiber has at most one unordered pair, giving q²M4=|T|²+2(S²−Q), exactly. Identities S²−|T|²=Σ_{t<u}|f(t)conj f(u)−conj f(t)f(u)|² and Q−S²/q=q^(−1)Σ_{t<u}(|f(t)|²−|f(u)|²)² give nonnegative global deficit; zero iff constant magnitude, aligned squares, thus λ sign choices and 2^(q−1) projective classes. For nonAPN, collision m≥2 increases constant-input fourth moment by 4m(m−1)/q² ≥8/q², proving iff and quantitative separation. The cubic x³ is APN by the 2-element kernel of u²+u. Quantifiers include q=2 and arbitrary complex inputs.
